messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted API (us-east-1) queue growth detected. p95 1.8s -> 18s, p99 2.9s -> 85s. Queue depth rising: 4k -> 18k in 9m. Autoprovisioner failing to create new GPU nodes (rate: 10m errors). Paging SRE oncall.
amanda: acknowledged. looking. paged infra. adding everyone.
diego: seeing a stream of failures from the provisioner: 
```
 2026-03-15T02:04:11Z provisioner: create_instance failed status=403 reason="quotaExceeded" project=redwood-inference-us-east-1
 2026-03-15T02:05:02Z provisioner: create_instance failed status=429 reason="rateLimitExceeded" cloudApi=compute.instances.insert
 ```
this matches provider-side quota and also 429 backoff loops in the provisioner.
ravi: confirmed customer traffic spike from a large partner integration — traffic multiplier ~6x typical. We had batching/kv-cache hit-rate drop so per-token cost spiked and more parallel requests landed.
tilly: support seeing >100 alerts from customers (timeouts / 504). Top impacted: partner-3, app-x, internal-loadtest. Customers reporting 504s and retries. I can start an incident bridge with CS if needed.
amanda: immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce free-tier concurrency/rate for non-SLAs by 50%; 2) enable a CPU/quantized fallback route for lower-priority traffic; 3) attempt manual scale of existing dedicated pools and trigger a force-reconcile for the provisioner; 4) contact cloud quota team if creates keep failing.
sean: I'll flip the routing rule to divert low-priority keyspace to redwood-small-q4 CPU variant. command: 
```
 # update routing policy
 redwoodctl routes update --selector tier=free --policy fallback_model=redwood-small-q4 --concurrency 0.5
 ```
amanda: applying temporary rate-limit via admin-ops: 
```
 PUT /admin/overrides/rate-limit
 {
   "selector": "tier:free",
   "concurrency_factor": 0.5,
   "reason": "emergency backlog mitigation 2026-03-15"
 }
 ```
diego: also discovered root cause on provisioner: service-account key rotation last night removed compute.instances.create IAM binding for the provisioner SA. When quota calls return 200 the provisioner still tries, but the IAM denied responses are interpreted as transient and we backoff. Log snippet: 
```
 2026-03-15T02:07:50Z iam: UpdateServiceAccount failed: user:provisioner-sa@redwood.iam does not have permission compute.instances.create
 ```
I've submitted an adhoc IAM fix to re-add the role. Applying now.
amanda: thanks. tilly, can you surface the top 3 impacted customers to PM/Sales? we need to contact them proactively.
tilly: will do. opening a shared doc + bridge. tagging support-bot to create an incident RFC.
support-bot: created incident bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-1767894321 | dial-in posted.
diego: IAM fix applied. forcing reconcile on provisioner: 
```
 kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/provisioner
 redwoodctl provisioner reconcile --force
 ```
watching events...
(2m)
 provisioner: reconcile: created 8 GPU instances in pool-us-east-1 (type: a100-80).
provisioner: create_instance succeeded id=i-0a1b2c3d
amanda: nice — queue depth starting to plateau. monitoring latency.
incident-bot: METRICS UPDATE: queue 18k -> 7.4k in 12m; p95 18s -> 4.5s; p99 85s -> 22s. error rate 12% -> 4%.
sean: small-q4 route is absorbing ~30% of free-tier requests, latency for that cohort is higher but within SLA for non-critical.
ravi: customers still seeing intermittent 504s while caches warm. I recommend keeping fallback + rate-limits for 45m and then slowly roll back.
amanda: agreed. next steps: 1) keep routing/rate limits; 2) monitor queue until <2k; 3) follow up with cloud quota team to request a formal limit increase; 4) document the IAM rotation gap and add preflight check to our deploys.
tilly: posting incident impact summary to #support-updates and emailing top-3. will update bridge.
sean: snapshot of provisioner logs/artifacts uploaded to /artifacts/incidents/1767894321 (s3 link in bridge doc).
amanda: handing off to ravi for night coverage. Ravi, I'm available for follow-ups but I'm stepping off pager. summary: provisioner IAM rotation removed compute.create binding causing provisioner backoff; manual IAM restore + forced reconcile created 8 GPUs; applied temporary rate-limits and CPU fallback for low-priority traffic; queue decreased from 18k -> 7.4k and p95/p99 trending down. watchlist: cloud quota escalate + add deploy preflight IAM check.
ravi: taking it. thanks amanda. I'll keep the bridge open, monitoring queue, and start the post-incident writeup. items for next oncall: confirm cloud quota increase or roll plan, review provisioning error telemetry, craft runbook entry for IAM rotation scenario.
amanda: :thumbsup: handing off at 02:46Z.
incident-bot: NOTE: Pager handoff recorded: from amanda -> ravi at 1767897189.
